added_lines: the church of our lady of lourdes serving the parishes of steelstown & culmore sunday 11th october 2026 28th sunday in ordinary time during his recent visit to the grotto of massabielle in lourdes, pope leo xiv made the fol lowing appeal. dear brothers and sisters: i would like to make an appeal that is particularly close to my heart, here in this place. it was here that the immaculate virgin appeared to saint bernadette with the rosary and, as it were, guided her in prayer. for this reason, today i invite all the faithful and all christian com munities to pray the holy rosary throughout the coming month of october, with the particular intention that wars may cease and that peace may be established among peoples in conflict. let us accompany this prayer with concrete acts of penance and mercy, committing ourselves always to fostering dialogue and reconcili ation. may our most holy mother intercede for us!” as we gather here in this church, dedicated to our lady of lourdes, let us take up the pope’s i nvitation and commit to praying the holy rosary each day for peace in our hearts and in our homes, in our country and in our world! the rosary is recited here on mondays at 6.30pm and on tuesdays-saturdays at 9.30am. queen of the most holy rosary, pray for us! confessions weekend saturday: after 10am mass; 5.45pm – 6.25pm sunday: 10.30am – 10.50am weekdays monday : 6.30pm – 6.55pm tuesday : 8.10am – 8.30am thursday : 9.30am – 09.50am mass times sundays vigil: 6.30pm sunday: 09.00am; 11.00am; 12.15pm weekdays monday – friday: 7.45am monday: 7.00pm tuesday – saturday: 10.00am devotions eucharistic adoration thursday: 08.00 – 09.55am 10.30am – 12 noon rosary before 10am mass divine mercy chaplet after 10am mass culmoe

mission sunday 18 october– next sunday is mission sunday, a day when we are given the opportun ity to express unity and solidarity with christian communities all over the world. contributions will be used to build simple mission churches, to educate seminarians as well as female reli gious novices, to assist in the formation of catechists and lay leaders, for building health facilities for children and adults as well as for providing emergency aid in times of war or natural disaster or to assist missionaries in their efforts to care for refugees. there is an envelope in your box for the mission sunday collection. parish cells – next weekend, after all masses, you are invited to the conference room to learn about the ‘parish cell system of evangelisation’. parish cells are small groups of 4 to 12 people who meet in their home every two weeks to deepen their faith and friendship, to encourage one another in living their christian faith each day, and to explore simple ways of sharing the gospel with others. for more information, visit: parishcellsireland.ie. bible alive renewal reminder– the parish order of bible alive is due for renewal in november. bible alive is a monthly booklet which provides commentary and reflection the readings used at mass each day plus articles relating to scripture, prayer and life. if you wish to order bib le alive for the next year, please contact the sacristan. cost is £30 per year or £3 per month. if paying by cheque, please make payable to:‘our lady of lourdes church’. donations-fr mcgeehan acknowledges a donation of £40 for those in need and also donations for the holy family parish in gaza. the columban young adults – are a new group for those aged 18 - 30 in the diocese, who are seeking a community of like-minded young adults who have christ at the centre of their l ives. our october event will be a holy hour and meditation next thursday 15th october, 7:00pm at our lady of lourdes church, steelstown, delivered by fr declan mcgeehan. the meditation will be followed by solemn benedic tion and light refreshments. we are actively seeking new members- please come along and bring a friend! the eucharistic miracles of the world-come and discover the remarkable stories of eucharistic miracles from around the world, brought together through the inspiring work of st carlo acutis. this exhibition offers an opportunity for prayer, reflection and a deepening faith. running until 16 october in st eugene’s cathedral hall, infirmary road, derry. admission is free, all welcome. rise & shine trust –group 110 (derry) do you know a young person who would benefit from a week of friendship, fun, faith and unforgettable memories in lourdes? rise & shine trust brings children (11+) and young adults with additional needs on a week-long pilgrimage holiday to lourdes each easter. the trip is free for our guests as our volunteers fundraise for it. for more information, and to apply, please see w ww.riseandshine.ie.
